about_blocks.text: TeDDs on Chapel: a five-client recovery program in Grand Falls
about_blocks.html: TeDDs on Chapel: a five-client recovery program in Grand Falls

about_blocks.text: TeDDs on Chapel Center for Recovery is a small private addiction program in Grand Falls (Grand-Sault), in northwestern New Brunswick. It treats adults with alcohol and drug addiction and takes no more than five people at a time. The centre runs 21, 30 and 42 day programs, and you can do them as a residential stay, online, or as a mix of the two.
about_blocks.html: TeDDs on Chapel Center for Recovery is a small private addiction program in Grand Falls (Grand-Sault), in northwestern New Brunswick. It treats adults with alcohol and drug addiction and takes no more than five people at a time. about_blocks.text: The program is built on the neuroscience of addiction. Staff teach clients how drinking and drug use change the brain, why cravings hold on so hard, and how the brain can recover through neuroplasticity. Counselling is one on one, and recovery.com lists cognitive behavioural therapy, nutrition counselling and online therapy among the methods. Clients also do a daily meditation session with biofeedback that tracks stress levels, an exercise class led by a certified trainer, and neurocognitive testing through Cambridge Brain Sciences to measure progress.

about_blocks.text: Privacy shapes a lot of how TeDDs works. There is no sign outside, notes taken during the program are handed back to the client when they leave, and the centre says it does not report to outside agencies. That is why it puts a particular focus on doctors, nurses, dentists and other licensed professionals, and it offers letters of support for people who want them.

about_blocks.text: The program is led by Christopher Ashton, program director and an internationally certified alcohol and drug counsellor, and Denise Duffie, executive director. The two have presented the TeDDs model at the Canadian Society of Addiction Medicine and the Canadian Counselling and Psychotherapy Association. Its recovery.com profile lists the programs in English, and the centre notes that Grand Falls itself is a bilingual town.

answer_blocks.text: TeDDs on Chapel is a small private addiction program in Grand Falls, New Brunswick, for adults dealing with alcohol or drug addiction. It offers residential, virtual and hybrid programs, and recovery.com also lists outpatient care. No more than five clients are in the program at once.

faqs.question: Is TeDDs suitable for doctors, nurses and other licensed professionals?

answer_blocks.text: Yes, TeDDs says its program was designed with licensed professionals in mind. There is no signage, notes are returned to you when you leave, and the centre says it is not required to report to outside agencies. It will write letters of support if you ask.
